finding: FusionDB can execute a bounded recursive CTE subset shaped as anchor UNION/UNION ALL recursive term.
evidence: cargo test --test sql_set_subquery passed recursive counter and UNION fixpoint tests.
impact: LDBC recursive queries no longer all stop at the generic WITH RECURSIVE unsupported error.

finding: After recursive CTE support, LDBC Query 14 moved to a CTE alias mismatch blocker.
evidence: Error changed from WITH RECURSIVE is not supported to CTE sg column count mismatch.
impact: Recursive CTE implementation changed the LDBC frontier but did not complete Query 14.

finding: LDBC Query 14 requires prefix-only CTE alias column renaming.
evidence: Regression test test_recursive_cte_alias_can_rename_prefix_columns covers sg(node, hops) AS (SELECT * FROM r).
impact: PostgreSQL-compatible CTE alias behavior is needed before Query 14 can reach deeper blockers.

finding: The current LDBC frontier is correlated NOT EXISTS / outer-column resolution in Query 14.
evidence: LdbcQuery14 fails with Column k_person2id not found in not exists(select * from sg y where y.link = k_person2id).
impact: BENCHPROD-103 should make EXISTS/NOT EXISTS subqueries aware of the current outer row rather than pre-materializing them globally.
